summary: POET Technologies Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, containing its condensed unaudited consolidated interim financial statements and management's discussion and analysis for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO and CFO certifications. The filing is a routine periodic financial report incorporating results into existing registration statements; it discloses no transaction, offer, or special-situation event. Cash and short-term investments totaled roughly $796 million; net loss widened versus the prior period. No board recommendation, advisors, or deal mechanics are relevant. There is no risk-arb angle; this is a standard earnings disclosure, not a special situation.
